## Big exercise: simulation {#simulation}

Answer probability questions by writing down the process and letting the computer run it a few thousand times. Start with the birthday problem — simulate it, then plot how the probability of a shared birthday grows with the number of people in the room. Then flip coins and resample counties until a familiar bell shape turns up on its own, bootstrap an estimate from a sample of 50 counties, and close by asking what every uncertainty number you just computed quietly assumed.

::: refs
[References]{.refs-label}

- [Prefresher, Ch. 12: Simulation](https://iqss.github.io/prefresher/16_simulation.html) — including the birthday problem
- [R Cookbook, Ch. 8: Probability](https://rc2e.com/probability)
- [Meng, "Statistical paradises and paradoxes in big data (I)", *Annals of Applied Statistics* 12(2), 2018](https://statistics.fas.harvard.edu/sites/g/files/omnuum10116/files/statistics-2/files/statistical_paradises_and_paradoxes.pdf)
:::
